title: Barn (upgrade workshop)
description: Tall barn-red drive-through workshop along Z: two side walls with three white-framed windows each, white corner boards and wall caps, a red gable over each doorway on a white header beam, a dark pitched roof with white fascia, workbenches inside along both walls, and a big blank light signboard (node `signboard`, front face UVs 0..1) on the +Z gable. Nodes walls / gables / roof / signboard so the game can hide the top while the combine is inside.
checks: FRONT tile: a tall open doorway you can see right through (the back doorway open too), a wide light signboard on a dark frame above it
3/4 tile: red walls, white corner boards and trim, a dark two-sided roof overhanging the walls
LEFT tile: three windows on the side wall
BACK tile: the same open doorway and gable as the front, without the signboard
TOP tile: a plain dark roof with a ridge down the middle along Z
